definitions.explanation: The area along the coast where land meets the sea.

examples.japanese: {海辺|うみべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧。
examples.english: To take a walk by the seaside.

examples.japanese: {海辺|うみべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}みたい→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I want to live by the sea.

examples.japanese: {海辺|うみべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{泊|と}まった→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed at a seaside hotel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{海辺|うみべ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have memories of playing at the seaside during summer vacation.

examples.japanese: {海辺|うみべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}くて→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{寒|さむ}くなる→寒い：00664_samui⟧。
examples.english: Seaside towns are windy, and it gets very cold in winter.

notes:
{海辺|うみべ} refers to the seaside area, the land along the coast where you can see and access the sea.

FORMS:
⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧ (sea) + {辺|べ} (area near) = seaside area

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {海辺|うみべ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧: to take a walk by the seaside
- {海辺|うみべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧: seaside town
- {海辺|うみべ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live by the sea
- {海辺|うみべ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧: to play at the beach
- {海辺|うみべ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧: seaside hotel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{浜辺|はまべ}→浜辺：17948_hamabe⟧: beach (sandy area by water)
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧: coast, shore (more geographic/formal)
- ⟦{砂浜|すなはま}→砂浜：12333_sunahama⟧: sandy beach (emphasis on sand)
- ⟦{浜|はま}→浜：05041_hama⟧: beach (shorter, common in place names)
- ⟦ビーチ→ビーチ：10163_biichi⟧: beach (from English, often for swimming beaches)

USAGE:
{海辺|うみべ} is a gentle, somewhat poetic word that evokes the atmosphere of being near the sea. ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧ is more neutral/geographic, while ⟦ビーチ→ビーチ：10163_biichi⟧ often implies a recreational swimming beach.
